files.description: One entry for every file under "The files to judge", keyed by its path, and for no other.

checked.description: What you checked for this file: the rules, and each other file you paired it with and the input you built for that pair.

findings.description: Every finding for this file, none left out and none merged into another; empty when it follows every rule.

rule.description: The rule it breaks, by its heading or the project rule.

ids.description: This file's id and, for a conflict, the other file's (domain/name).

input.description: One concrete input on which the problem shows, quoted in full.
